action.title: Identifies if a record is to be upserted (inserted or updated) or (hard) deleted.

id.description: The unique identifier for a post policy record.

key.title: Contains post policy configurations for courses and individual assignments.

course_id.description: The ID of the course referenced by this policy. Note that this is always set even if the policy refers to a specific assignment within a course.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when a `post_policies` record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of when a `post_policies` record was updated.

assignment_id.description: The ID of the assignment referenced by this policy, or NULL if the policy refers to a course at large.

post_manually.description: For post policies associated with an assignment, whether submissions receiving grades or comments should be posted to the student automatically. For post policies associated with a course, this value will be applied by default to assignments created in the course.

value.title: Contains post policy configurations for courses and individual assignments.
